title: Page 4
content_zh:
转头向妈妈微笑着说谢谢的苏大哥彷佛变了个人似的，一扫刚刚一脸的讥弄嘲讽，又戴上温文有礼的面具。
她不由得感到一阵寒意。
吃饭的时候她一直心不在焉，吃得很少，看苏劲沧的时候多，但多半是带着疑惑的。
「劲沧你事业那么成功，想必感情也很顺遂吧？现在有女朋友吗？」叶金富一边捧他，一边也是想要打听消息。
「没有。」苏劲沧回答。「忙着事业，根本就没有空去想那方面的事情。」
「好、好！这才是有志气的男人。不过劲沧啊，你现在事业也稳定了，也是时候该考虑成家了吧？」
像是早料到他想要说的话，苏劲沧从容的擦擦嘴角，不疾不徐的弯起一抹笑弧。
「叶伯伯说的很有道理。」
受到这句话的鼓舞，叶金富倾身向前，涎着脸笑着。「那你觉得我们家欢欢怎么样？我们欢欢可是从小就一直喜欢你吶！她又乖巧、长得又漂亮，最重要的是对你一心一意。」
「爸！」她又羞又窘的叫了一声，爸简直就是在强迫推销嘛。
十年不见，第一次见面爸就想要把她推销给苏大哥，想都不用想就知道他会怎么回答。
虽然她以前怎么被拒绝都要黏着他，早训练出铜墙铁壁般的厚脸皮，可是……可是她也不想在久别重逢的当下，重温被他拒绝的难堪呀。
「好啊。」他清清淡淡的说道，就像是在说菜很好吃，他可以再吃一碗饭，还是饭后来点水果当点心似的……
总之，就是不像是在承诺终身大事！
叶咏欢瞠目结舌，难以置信的看着他。
他弯起嘴角，给了她一个莫测高深的微笑。
第2章(1)
国内知名银行董事的独生女儿出阁，而且对象是今年新兴起的科技新贵、炙手可热的黄金单身汉，这则消息这几天占据了各大媒体版面上。
据说婚戒有五克拉这么大，婚纱是出自法国名设计师手工订制，婚礼席开百桌，邀请的政商名流不计其数。
这几天叶咏欢接到很多很久没联络的同学的恭贺电话，她们都羡慕她的好运气。在谈话的过程中，难免有些人不经意的透露出些许妒意。

「你真好呵！有这么好的家世，又嫁了这么好的老公。不过也不难理解啦！毕竟两家联姻对彼此的事业都有帮助嘛！」
叶咏欢不太清楚自己是不是被酸了。同学的话听起来有点像说苏大哥会娶她是因为爸爸的关系。
对这个并不是太熟的大学同学，她也只能礼貌上的道谢，然后把电话挂上。
也难怪同学会这么说，连她自己到现在都不相信自己的好运。苏大哥又聪明又厉害，她从小就崇拜仰慕的人，居然要跟她结婚了。一点真实感都没有……
手下意识的碰触那颗夸张的大钻戒，几天下来这已经变成她的习惯了，好像这么做能够让自己心安。可是现在钻戒不在手指上，她微微慌乱了下才想起钻戒在苏劲沧那里，等一下他会在婚礼开始时再在宾客面前替她戴上。
她整了整身上的白纱礼服。应该不是作梦，礼服箍得她几乎无法呼吸，会有感觉表示不是作梦……
敲门声传来，她转过头，叶金富出现在新娘休息室的门口。
「准备好了没？婚礼开始了，该进场了。」
等会，爸爸要牵着她的手把她交给苏大哥。叶咏欢紧张的吞了口口水。婚礼结束后她就成为苏大哥的妻子，童年的梦想实现了，有多少人能够实现童年的梦想？也许她真的是幸运的。
「发什么呆呢？快过来啊！」
父亲催促了，她才急忙站起来。
叶金富忍住想叹气的冲动。「你这孩子，从小就傻气又天真，也没有什么长处，现在我好不容易替你找了这门好亲事，你可得好好把握。劲沧这年轻人我很看好他，以后说不定会成为台湾科技界的首富，我们能在这时候就跟他建立关系真是太好了。」
叶咏欢眨眨眼。怎么爸爸的话让她觉得这婚姻只是一纸紧密双方关系的商业契约？
这跟她想象中出嫁前感人的妇女对谈有些落差，她不由得愣了愣。
「又发呆？快走了！」
叶金富白了她一眼，忙不迭的把她牵出去，就像是怕耽误了时间，乘龙快婿会跑掉似的。
叶咏欢有些迷惑的被父亲拉着走上红毯，走进宴席会场，来宾里没有几个是她认识的。他们拍手、微笑的看着她，她有些慌乱、不习惯成为那么多人注目的焦点，只能紧张的微笑。
进入会场时旁边摆了一幅婚纱照，照片里的她依偎在苏大哥身边，笑得很满足，苏大哥面对镜头，淡漠的脸上看不出任何情绪。
她记得那时在苏大哥怀中的自己有多么快乐，筹办婚礼期间他一直都很忙，什么事情都说她决定就好。她是尽量什么都自己处理了，可是拍婚纱一定要他参与呵！
他比约定的时间晚了一个小时才到，而且来的时候还一脸不耐烦。她告诉自己，男人嘛！都是讨厌拍照的。所以拍了半小时，他说他得走了，剩下的她自己拍，她没有异议，想着他很辛苦，工作一定很多、很忙。

他为她抽出半个小时的时间，已经够让她感到幸福了。
那是一张好照片呢！把苏大哥高大英挺的模样完全彰显出来。他的头发、眉毛、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴巴，没有一处不完美的，而这么完美的他手揽着她，她还是第一次跟他这么靠近呢！
叶金富扯了她的手一下，她才发现自己竟然看着照片里的苏劲沧傻笑，她急忙回神，随着结婚进行曲的音乐往前走。
苏劲沧等得有些不耐烦了。婚礼、宴客……太多的繁文缛节消耗了他的耐性，他开始怀疑自己做这些到底值不值得。
等了很久，新娘才慢吞吞的来到他身旁。他想瞪她一眼，责备她的缓慢，却在视线对上她时愣住。
在半透明的白纱底下，她张着大眼迷恋的仰望着他。
那种眼神对他而言不陌生，可是今天的她特别不一样。一直以来都把她当成当年那个一把鼻涕、一把眼泪跟在他身后的爱哭鬼，然后眼前的她，一袭白纱巧妙的衬托出她秾纤合度的好身材，绾起的长发露出优美的玉颈，那一截白净的肌肤竟瞬间夺走他的呼吸……
他甩开那怪异的感觉，伸出手，有些粗鲁的把她从叶金富的手中接过来。
主婚人、证婚人、介绍人每个人讲的话都又臭又长，但是他只能撑着微笑听完。幸好就要结束了，他僵着笑自我安慰。
在众人的鼓噪之下，他不只将戒指套在新娘的无名指上，还低头亲吻了她。她的唇微微颤抖着，脸儿很红很红。
本来只是一个虚应故事的吻，竟因为她的唇尝起来意外的甜美而让他流连好一阵子才放开。
这会她不只脸红，双唇也微微肿胀起来，低胸的礼服更是遮掩不住胸前那片粉红色诱人的肌肤。
他皱起眉，拉起她的披肩遮住那引人犯罪的春光，就是不想要别的男人看到。
「我以后会当你的好妻子的。」她低声在他耳边羞怯的说了这句话。
那是甜蜜的诺言。莫名的，他竟没有嗤之以鼻，反而有种暖暖甜甜的感觉滑过心间……
婚礼过后，他们回到苏劲沧位于台北郊区的豪宅，可是她连好好看看这个未来她将要生活的地方的机会都没有，匆匆换了衣服，苏劲沧就把她塞进车里，直奔机场。
content_en:
Brother Su, who turned to his mother with a smile and said thank you, seemed to have changed. He swept away the ridicule and sarcasm on his face and put on a mask of gentleness and courtesy again.
She couldn't help but feel a chill.
She had been absent-minded during the meal, eating very little and looking at Su Jincang more often, but mostly with doubts.
"Jin Cang, your career is so successful, so your relationship must be going well, right? Do you have a girlfriend now?" Ye Jinfu praised him while also wanting to inquire about the news.
"No." Su Jincang replied. "I'm so busy with my career that I don't have time to think about that."
"Okay, okay! This is a man with ambition. But Jin Cang, your career is stable now, it's time to consider starting a family, right?"
As if she had anticipated what he wanted to say, Su Jincang wiped the corners of his mouth calmly and curved a smile slowly.
"What Uncle Ye said makes sense."
Encouraged by these words, Ye Jinfu leaned forward, smiling with saliva. "Then what do you think of our Huanhuan? Our Huanhuan has always liked you since she was a child! She is well-behaved, beautiful, and most importantly, she is devoted to you."
"Dad!" She yelled in shame and embarrassment. Dad was simply forcing a sales pitch.
After not seeing each other for ten years, my father wanted to sell her to Brother Su when we first met. I knew without even thinking how he would answer.
Although she had always clung to him no matter how much she was rejected in the past, and she had already developed a thick-skinned attitude like an iron wall, but...she didn't want to relive the embarrassment of being rejected by him now that they were reunited after a long separation.
"Okay." He said calmly, as if he was saying that the food was delicious and he could have another bowl of rice, or order some fruit as a snack after the meal...
All in all, it just doesn’t look like you’re committing to something big for life!
Ye Yonghuan was stunned and looked at him in disbelief.
He curved the corners of his mouth and gave her an unpredictable smile.
Chapter 2(1)
The only daughter of a well-known domestic bank director is out of the government, and the target is this year's newly-emerged technology upstart and a hot golden bachelor. This news has occupied all major media pages these days.
It is said that the wedding ring was as big as five carats, the wedding dress was handmade by a famous French designer, there were hundreds of wedding banquets, and countless political and business celebrities were invited.
In the past few days, Ye Yonghuan has received many congratulatory calls from classmates whom she has not contacted for a long time. They are all envious of her good luck. During the conversation, it was inevitable that some people would inadvertently reveal a little jealousy.
"How nice of you! You have such a good family background and you are married to such a good husband. But it is not difficult to understand! After all, the marriage between two families will help each other's careers!"
Ye Yonghuan wasn't sure if she was being hurt. The classmate's words sounded a bit like saying that Brother Su would marry her because of his father's relationship.
To this college classmate whom she was not very familiar with, she could only politely thank him and hang up the phone.
No wonder her classmates would say this, even she herself still doesn't believe in her good luck. Brother Su is smart and powerful. The person she has admired and admired since childhood is actually marrying her. There is no sense of reality at all...
She subconsciously touched the exaggeratedly large diamond ring. Over the past few days, this had become her habit, as if doing so would make her feel at ease. But now that the diamond ring was not on her finger, she panicked for a moment before remembering that the diamond ring was with Su Jincang, and he would put it on for her in front of the guests at the beginning of the wedding.
She adjusted her white gauze dress. It must not be a dream. The dress was so tight that she could hardly breathe. There was a feeling that it was not a dream...
There was a knock on the door, and she turned her head. Ye Jinfu appeared at the door of the bride's lounge.
"Are you ready? The wedding has started, it's time to enter."
Later, dad will hold her hand and hand her over to Brother Su. Ye Yonghuan swallowed nervously. After the wedding, she became Brother Su’s wife.The dream has come true. How many people can realize their childhood dreams? Maybe she really is lucky.
"Why are you dazed? Come here quickly!"
Her father urged her and she hurriedly stood up.
Ye Jinfu resisted the urge to sigh. "You kid, you have been stupid and naive since you were a child, and you have no good qualities. Now that I have finally found a good match for you, you have to take advantage of it. I am very optimistic about this young man Jin Cang. He may become the richest man in Taiwan's technology industry in the future. It is great that we can establish a relationship with him at this time."
Ye Yonghuan blinked. Why did her father's words make her think that this marriage was just a business contract that closely bound the relationship between the two parties?
This was somewhat different from the touching conversation she had imagined between women before getting married, and she couldn't help but be stunned.
"In a daze again? Let's go!"
Ye Jinfu rolled his eyes at her and hurriedly led her out, as if he was afraid that his son-in-law would run away if he wasted time.
Ye Yonghuan was a little confused and was pulled onto the red carpet by her father and walked into the banquet venue. She knew few of the guests. They clapped their hands and looked at her with smiles. She was a little flustered and not used to being the focus of so many people's attention, so she could only smile nervously.
When she entered the venue, there was a wedding photo next to her. In the photo, she was leaning against Brother Su, smiling contentedly. Brother Su faced the camera, with no emotion on his indifferent face.
She remembered how happy she was in Brother Su's arms at that time. He had been very busy during the wedding preparations, and she could decide everything. She tried her best to handle everything by herself, but he had to participate in the wedding photo shoot!
He arrived an hour later than the agreed time and looked impatient when he arrived. She told herself, man! They all hate taking pictures. So after half an hour of filming, he said he had to leave, and she filmed the rest by herself. She had no objection, thinking that he was working very hard and must have a lot of work and be very busy.
The fact that he spared half an hour for her was enough to make her happy.
That’s a great photo! It fully demonstrates the tall and handsome appearance of Brother Su. There was no imperfection in his hair, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of nose, or mouth. And with him holding her hand so perfectly, it was the first time she was so close to him!
Ye Jinfu pulled her hand, and she realized that she was actually looking at Su Jincang in the photo and smirking. She quickly came to her senses and walked forward to the music of the wedding march.
Su Jincang was a little impatient with waiting. Weddings, banquets... too many red tapes consumed his patience, and he began to doubt whether it was worth it.
After waiting for a long time, the bride slowly came to him. He wanted to glare at her and scold her for her slowness, but froze when his eyes met hers.
Under the translucent white gauze, she looked up at him with wide eyes and fascination.
That look was familiar to him, but she was particularly different today. He had always regarded her as the crybaby who followed him with a fistful of snot and tears. Then he saw her in front of him. She was dressed in white gauze that cleverly highlighted her slender figure. Her long hair was tied up to reveal her graceful jade neck. That stretch of fair skin actually took away his breath in an instant...
He shook off the weird feeling, stretched out his hand, and took her somewhat roughly from Ye Jinfu's hand.
The officiant, the witness, and the introducer each spoke very long words, but he could only listen to them with a smile. Fortunately it was about to end, he comforted himself with a stiff smile.
Under the clamor of everyone, he not only put the ring on the bride's ring finger, but also lowered his head and kissed her. Her lips were trembling slightly, and her face was very red.
It was just a kiss that was meant to fill a story, but because her lips tasted unexpectedly sweet, he lingered for a while before letting go.
At this moment, not only did she blush, her lips were also slightly swollen, and the low-cut dress could not hide the pink allure on her chest.human skin.
He frowned and pulled up her shawl to cover up the crime-inducing spring scenery, just not wanting other men to see it.
"I will be your good wife from now on." She whispered this shyly in his ear.
That's a sweet promise. Inexplicably, he didn't sneer, but instead felt a warm and sweet feeling slipping through his heart...
After the wedding, they returned to Su Jincang's mansion in the suburbs of Taipei, but she didn't even have a chance to take a good look at the place where she would live in the future. After hurriedly changing her clothes, Su Jincang put her into the car and went straight to the airport.
